description: For pages published without an API key (previews): ask PubSpace to email your human one link that keeps every page under a claim token. Callable without an API key. Only call it after the human has told you their email; never invent or guess one. Opening the link shows a Keep button; pressing it, or one bare POST to the link (do that if the human pastes it to you), moves the pages into a free PubSpace space at <name>.pubspace.ai (or into the account they already have, as many pages as its plan holds): the preview links redirect there and stop expiring, even after the 7 days. Pass claim_token from publish_page, or omit it in the session that published the preview. Returns { ok, sent, email, expiresInHours, tell_user }: relay tell_user. The answer is the same whether or not the address already has an account. Once the human clicks, the pages that moved answer preview_already_claimed: ask them for their API key to keep updating those. Pages that did not fit an existing account's plan stay previews; the claim token still updates them, and calling claim_page again keeps them once there is room. When every page has moved, the claim token stops working. Fails with invalid_email, disposable_email_not_allowed, email_opted_out, invalid_claim_token, preview_already_claimed or rate_limited.

claim_token.description: The claimToken publish_page returned. Optional in the MCP session that published the preview.

email.description: The human's real email address, as they gave it to you. The claim link goes here.

name: claim_page
title: Keep a preview with an email link
